Good instinct — migrations that don't start with an inventory end with a rollback.
Phase 1: find every read/write path to the current JSON store so we know what the
And WAL mode — should we turn it on from day one?
Yes. WAL gives us concurrent readers during the migration backfill without blocking
writers. Set `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL` at open, once, not per query.
